summary: Roose writes that AI is advancing fast and that its risks are real, and he calls for the public, not just AI companies, to shape its course.

statements.quote: I think what is true, incontrovertibly, is that these systems are very capable.
I think the technology may be inevitable, but our response to it is not.
I think we’re left now with this world where the benefits are still a little ways off. But the risks are here right now.
I’m very heartened that people outside the bubble are waking up. AI is too important to be left to the labs!
The problem with the view that we should ignore the scary sci-fi AI risks in favor of the immediate problems is that the scary sci-fi risks keep becoming immediate problems.
